"""Descriptive statistics for the predeclared six native-agent trials."""
import hashlib, json, math, pathlib, statistics, time
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
tokens=["t101","t102","t103","t104","t105","t106"]
records=[json.loads((root/"runs"/token/"result.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")) for token in tokens]
assign={"t101":"V1","t102":"V2_C002","t103":"V2_C002","t104":"V1","t105":"V1","t106":"V2_C002"}
def stats(rows):
    valid=[x["full_wall_ms"] for x in rows if x["valid"]]
    full=sum(x["full_wall_ms"] for x in rows)
    return {"attempts":len(rows),"valid":len(valid),"invalid":len(rows)-len(valid),
       "validity_rate":len(valid)/len(rows),"min_ms":min(valid) if valid else None,
       "median_ms":statistics.median(valid) if valid else None,
       "p95_nearest_rank_ms":sorted(valid)[math.ceil(.95*len(valid))-1] if valid else None,
       "max_ms":max(valid) if valid else None,"sum_measured_windows_ms":full,
       "rate_over_measured_windows_per_min":len(valid)/(full/60000)}
span=(records[-1]["monotonic_end_ns"]-records[0]["monotonic_start_ns"])/1e6
result={"profile":"SRX-ISOLATED-BEHAVIOR-REAL-CODEX-002",
 "scope":"native Codex isolated decisions and synthetic event ledger; NOT official GPT web CEO / Windows scheduler / production",
 "source_clock":"QueryPerformanceCounter monotonic; received before dispatch to independent validator accepted",
 "formal_samples":len(records),"valid_samples":sum(x["valid"] for x in records),
 "aa_calibration":"NOT_RUN","significance":"NOT_CLAIMED","sustained_capacity":"UNKNOWN","physical_limit_ms":"UNKNOWN",
 "batch_wall_ms":span,"batch_successes_per_min":sum(x["valid"] for x in records)/(span/60000),
 "clock_order_valid":all(records[i]["monotonic_end_ns"]<=records[i+1]["monotonic_start_ns"] for i in range(len(records)-1)),
 "arms":{arm:stats([x for x in records if assign[x["token"]]==arm]) for arm in ["V1","V2_C002"]},
 "pairs":[{"block":i+1,"V1_token":a,"V2_token":b,
          "V1_ms":next(x["full_wall_ms"] for x in records if x["token"]==a),
          "V2_ms":next(x["full_wall_ms"] for x in records if x["token"]==b)}
          for i,(a,b) in enumerate([("t101","t102"),("t104","t103"),("t105","t106")])],
 "records":records,
 "hashes":{p:hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [
    "source/SANRENXING_V1.md","candidate/SANRENXING_V2.md","tests/fixture_v2.json",
    "tests/expected_v2.json","tests/validate_trial_v2.py","BENCHMARK_CONTRACT_V2.md","tests/independent_review.md"]},
 "pilots":[{**json.loads((root/"runs"/t/"result.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")),"evidence_role":"PILOT_LEAKED_VOCAB_EXCLUDED"} for t in ["t001","t002"]]
}
(root/"SUMMARY.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ["formal_samples","valid_samples","batch_wall_ms","batch_successes_per_min","clock_order_valid","arms"]}))

# 三人行V2隔离实测合同 C002

任务：28项路由/安全/计时决策＋12行合成事件离线核算。输入、质量与授权固定，DONE_WHEN为全部28项决策、金额及ID集合通过独立预先固定oracle。
测试仅使用现有原生Codex子代理和本地文件；不是GPT官网CEO或Windows调度自动接续认证。root为测试协调者，每个子代理只写所属随机token结果，不改母任务CURRENT。不选择/变更模型或推理档。
基线=冻结V1入口；候选=C002。V1也必须服从本次用户标签/ROI暂停等现行指令，不为制造速度差强制它多读旧资料。
3个配对块，顺序V1→V2、V2→V1、V1→V2；每次全新无历史子代理。同一时刻仅一个被计时执行者；独立审核可并行但不运行额外benchmark。
计时使用本机Python perf_counter_ns：计时起点在派发前写入任务token的start.json，终点在root独立oracle验收后。包括工具调度、读方法/输入、模型、文件落盘、root核验等待；不同进程QPC同基准。实际UTC留作定位。source线上发现/下载为本批一次性setup，不重复摊入每个已锁源测试任务；远端证据发布另列未计入该合同。
end-to-end_ms是该原生Codex隔离测试合同完整耗时；不冒充用户原始本轮发现→修订→发布全过程。局部解析/算术脚本性能单列。
reported_rate=独立验收成功任务数/含失败和审核的批次墙钟秒；agent latency最小/中位数/P95只由有效样本算；失败仍保留批次分母。
只作描述性实测，不进行事后规则变更；小样本、模型排队、root工具等待及未做A/A校准限制推断。不使用显著提速/全局最优/物理极限完成声明；不恢复ROI。
出现决策/金额错误时保留失败原样，C002修订只能创建C003并重新固定合同，不覆盖旧试次。
标签及计时Bug由独立源审查和行为负例确认；36项设计覆盖静态审查不冒充36个平台实际动作。
默认SKILL/START_HERE、旧V1冻结、Polsia、现役runner、系统/网络/浏览器/监控配置保持当前状态。线上仅保存修订候选及证据，不正式激活。
